title: framework/ai: the date folders are gone and can't come back; Inbox cards move into the sessions store next

owner_note.text: `ai/2026-10-12` (6 tasks) and `ai/2026-10-13` moved into the sessions store by script, and every old link still opens. Every script now builds its path through TaskDirs, which refuses a new date folder. I decided the one tree is the sessions store, with the Inbox cards moving into `ai/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/cards/` once their readers share one path resolver (that is the next brief). The alternative, moving the whole store up to `ai/YYYY/`, was rejected: about 15 times more work and 164 folder merges.
